title: Policy-learning training-session and promotion tests match current contracts
verdict: all seven failures were stale tests; no production regression found; production code unchanged

findings.cause: docker-compose.yml put policy-learning-svc behind profiles [research, root] and the scheduler behind [root, workers]; the nonexistent profile 'policy-learning-shadow-eval-scheduler' no longer selected either service.
findings.fix: docker compose config now uses --profile root, which carries both services and operator-bff. Assertions unchanged.

findings.cause: The preview field was not moved. A failed evaluation now hands off to Consultation and fails closed (runtime_evidence_unavailable, ConsultationClientError 'consultation service URL is not configured') when the owner is unreachable, so the job failed and had no preview.
findings.fix: Added a consultation_owner fixture that runs the real Consultation ASGI app over HTTP with auth required, used by both tests. No mock of the owner boundary; assertions unchanged.

findings.cause: Governance approval_decision now rejects empty conditions with "'approved_with_conditions' requires nonempty conditions"; still HTTP 422 and still no partial persistence.
findings.fix: Expected message updated to the current text. Status, no-partial-state assertions unchanged.
